sentences.text: `` Dirty Diana '' is a song by American artist Michael Jackson .	Michael Jackson	Michael Jackson
It is the ninth track on Jackson 's seventh studio album , Bad .	Bad	Bad (album)
The song was released by Epic Records on April 18 , 1988 as the fifth single from the album .	Epic	Epic Records	Epic Records	Epic Records

It presents a harder rock sound similar to `` Beat It '' from Thriller and a guitar solo played by Steve Stevens .	Beat It	Beat It	Thriller	Thriller (Michael Jackson album)	Steve Stevens	Steve Stevens
`` Dirty Diana '' was written and co-produced by Jackson , and produced by Quincy Jones .	Quincy Jones	Quincy Jones
The songs lyrics pertain to groupies .
`` Dirty Diana '' has a moderate tempo and is played in the key of G minor .	tempo	tempo	key	Key (music)	G minor	G minor
`` Dirty Diana '' received mixed reviews from contemporary music critics , but was a commercial success worldwide in 1988 , charting at No. 1 on the United States Billboard Hot 100 .
The song also charted within the top ten in multiple countries , including the United Kingdom , France , Italy , and New Zealand .
`` Dirty Diana '' was the fifth and final Hot 100 number one single from Bad .	Bad	Bad (album)
In 2009 , after Jackson 's death in June , the song re-entered charts , mainly due to digital download sales .
A music video for `` Dirty Diana '' was filmed in front of a live audience and released in 1988 .
